subject: design/argus-journal-type-recovery
statement: Shared-account Git stamps remain audit evidence, not adversarial isolation from a drive able to invoke Git. Exact-head approval under trusted-mainline policy, memory/code/document predicates and host protection govern merge. Pyxis Source continues its documented legacy-check exemption while retaining attribution; installed consumers retain the full document gate.
